workflow: A text-search operation scans candidate starting positions within a bounded character buffer.
A candidate match fails at the final valid position, but the skip heuristic examines the following character to choose the next advance.
The lookahead is performed without confirming that the following character remains inside the buffer.
The one-past-end read causes a heap-buffer-overflow and may terminate instrumented execution.
summary: Unbounded lookahead reads beyond a text buffer during search
decision_reason: The failure mechanism is materially the same as the existing insufficient-lookahead cluster: a text-processing path assumes a following character is available and reads one past the valid input boundary.
